name: redo_document
description: Re-apply the state undone by the last revert_document (pops the per-session redo stack, restores it, commits as new head). Success carries advisory changedValues [{nodeId,before,after}] (pre-redo live text -> restored text, same bounds as save/preview). Empty stack fails with E_NOT_FOUND plus atLatestState:true (a fresh execute_batch edit clears redo, and each redo consumes one entry). Optional author (<=100 chars, default ASTra Agent) + reason (<=500 chars, preferred over message) with the same hygiene as save/revert. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {ok:true,revision,dirty:false}. A successful execute_batch clears the redo stack (fresh edits invalidate redo). ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
